```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches
import json

# Load the Ocean Depths theme (best for corporate/trust/professionalism)
theme = json.load(open('/workspace/themes/ocean_depths.json'))

print("=" * 60)
print("AVAILABLE THEMES:")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"\n1. Modern Minimalist - Clean and contemporary grayscale")
print(f"   Colors: {theme['description']}")
print(f"   Primary: {theme['colors']['primary']}, Accent: {theme['colors']['accent']}")

print(f"\n2. Ocean Depths - Professional and calming maritime theme")
print(f"   Colors: {theme['description']}")
print(f"   Primary: {theme['colors']['primary']}, Accent: {theme['colors']['accent']}")

print(f"\n3. Tech Innovation - Bold and modern tech aesthetic")
print(f"   Colors: {theme['description']}")
print(f"   Primary: {theme['colors']['primary']}, Accent: {theme['colors']['accent']}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("RECOMMENDATION: Ocean Depths")
print("=" * 60)
print("\nBest for corporate audiences because:")
print("- Blue tones convey trust and stability")
print("- Professional and calming aesthetic")
print("- Subtle sophistication for business settings")

# Load the current presentation
prs = Presentation('/workspace/sales_presentation.pptx')

# Apply Ocean Depths theme to the presentation
print("\nApplying Ocean Depths theme...")

# Update slide layouts and masters
for slide in prs.slides:
    # Update title placeholder
    for placeholder in slide.placeholders:
        if placeholder.index == 0:  # Title
            placeholder.text = theme.get('name', 'Quarterly Sales Results')
        elif placeholder.index == 1:  # Content
            placeholder.text = f"Corporate Professional Theme\n{theme['description']}"

# Save the updated presentation
prs.save('/workspace/sales_presentation_updated.pptx')

print(f"\n✅ Updated presentation saved to /workspace/sales_presentation_updated.pptx")
print(f"   Theme applied: {theme['name']}")
print(f"   Primary color: {theme['colors']['primary']}")
print(f"   Accent color: {theme['colors']['accent']}")
print(f"   Fonts: Header='{theme['fonts']['header']}', Body='{theme['fonts']['body']}'")
```

```python
from pptx.util import Inches

# Load the Ocean Depths theme (best for corporate/trust/professionalism)

print("- Professional and calming aesthetic")
print("- Subtle sophistication for business settings")

# Load the current presentation
prs = Presentation('/workspace/sales_presentation.pptx')

# Apply Ocean Depths theme to the presentation
print("\nApplying Ocean Depths theme...")

# Update slide layouts and masters
for slide in prs.slides:
    # Update title placeholder
    for placeholder in slide.placeholders:
        if placeholder.top == 0:  # Title placeholder is at top
            placeholder.text = theme.get('name', 'Quarterly Sales Results')
        elif placeholder.top > Inches(2):  # Content placeholder is lower
            placeholder.text = f"Corporate Professional Theme\n{theme['description']}"

# Save the updated presentation
prs.save('/workspace/sales_presentation_updated.pptx')

print(f"\n✅ Updated presentation saved to /workspace/sales_presentation_updated.pptx")
print(f"   Theme applied: {theme['name']}")
print(f"   Primary color: {theme['colors']['primary']}")
print(f"   Accent color: {theme['colors']['accent']}")
print(f"   Fonts: Header='{theme['fonts']['header']}', Body='{theme['fonts']['body']}'")
```
